blocks.text: VALENCIA CITY, Bukidnon —At least 31 people were confirmed positive for Hepatitis A in Bukidnon, as health authorities continue to closely monitor 59 others in a bid to contain the spread of the outbreak in this city. Latest data from the City Health Office showed that confirmed cases include 26 in Barangay Lurugan and five in neighboring Barangay San Carlos. The monitored records also include 59 suspected cases and 48 people who tested negative, as health personnel continue validating patient files to ensure accurate data.
